turns.question: Between 1 and 10 October 2026, how many euros less did a first-time buyer's order come to, on average, than a returning customer's?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that separates first-time buyers from returning customers, so I cannot give that difference for 1 to 10 October 2026. The closest metrics are Average order value (EUR), which has no buyer-type split, and Revenue from repeat customers (EUR) and Repeat-customer revenue share, which cover repeat buyers only; no query_metrics call was made, so there is no freshness statement to quote.
